variants.headline: Looking back: union calls a strike
variants.sub: A strike has been called by the union {name}.
variants.body:
We return to {first_reported}. Our report recorded this: The union {name} had called a strike.

A union has called a strike. That is the news, before somebody supplies a deserted factory, a furious owner or a perfect speech on a picket line. Working people and employers can be judged without that scenery. Keep the attention on the call and the responsibilities it raises.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

We criticise {target} in this dispute. Labour relations call for a responsible standard, and a strike call is an appropriate moment to question whether the interests at stake have been handled adequately.

variants.headline: Looking back: a call to withhold labour
variants.sub: The union {name} has issued a call for strike action.
variants.body:
Looking back to {first_reported}, this was the news: A strike had been called by the union {name}.

A union has called a strike. That is the news, before somebody supplies a deserted factory, a furious owner or a perfect speech on a picket line. Working people and employers can be judged without that scenery. Keep the attention on the call and the responsibilities it raises.

Time changes the distance from an event, not the need to judge it carefully. Any claim about improvement or deterioration needs more than a recollection of the original news.

We criticise {target} in this dispute. Labour relations call for a responsible standard, and a strike call is an appropriate moment to question whether the interests at stake have been handled adequately.

variants.headline: Looking back: work becomes the subject of a strike call
variants.sub: The union {name} has called a strike.
variants.body:
The headline belongs to {first_reported}. Our original account recorded this: The union {name} had issued a call for strike action.

A union has called a strike. That is the news, before somebody supplies a deserted factory, a furious owner or a perfect speech on a picket line. Working people and employers can be judged without that scenery. Keep the attention on the call and the responsibilities it raises.

What has changed since then should be examined against that original record. What has not changed is the need to distinguish an established event from the hopes or fears attached to it.

We criticise {target} in this dispute. Labour relations call for a responsible standard, and a strike call is an appropriate moment to question whether the interests at stake have been handled adequately.
